step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identification of Nodes: Extracted all 10 visual entities from the whiteboard and video transcript. Source databases (structured and semi-structured) and Tableau are mapped to 'ThirdParty' as per strict vocabulary rules. Native AWS services (DMS, S3, KMS, Lambda, Glue, Aurora) are mapped to their respective service names.
2. Note Assimilation: Integrated details from the audio transcript regarding data types (loan origination, collections, bureau), security measures (KMS encryption for sensitive fields), execution details (PySpark, serverless ETL in Glue), database decisions (Aurora PG for concurrency without licensing fees), and workflow management (Lambda).
3. Edge & Flow Identification: 
- Flow 0: Ingestion workflow where structured and semi-structured sources are pulled by DMS into the RAW S3 bucket.
- Flow 1: Processing workflow where Glue reads raw data from S3 RAW, transforms it using business logic, writes processed data to S3 PROCESSED, and loads it into Aurora PostgreSQL.
- Flow 2: Analytics/Reporting workflow where Tableau connects to Aurora PostgreSQL to render dashboards.

graph.name: Bajaj Housing Finance Serverless Data Pipeline and Data Mart Architecture
graph.notes: Serverless data pipeline and data mart architecture built by Bajaj Housing Finance Limited (BHFL) to ingest, transform, encrypt, and serve analytical data for financial reporting.

nodes.name: Data Sources (Structured)
nodes.notes: Structured transactional databases including loan origination system, loan management, and collections.

nodes.name: Data Sources (Semi-Structured)
nodes.notes: Semi-structured data sources from external systems like credit bureaus.

nodes.name: DMS
nodes.notes: AWS Database Migration Service configured to ingest data from both structured and semi-structured sources.

nodes.name: RAW
nodes.notes: Staging layer and data lake storing raw ingested data encrypted with KMS.

nodes.name: KMS
nodes.notes: AWS Key Management Service used to encrypt customer sensitive data such as names, phone numbers, and addresses.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Used for orchestration of workflow execution.

nodes.name: GLUE
nodes.notes: Serverless ETL using PySpark for complex business rules, data quality checks, error handling, and auditing.

nodes.name: PROCESSED
nodes.notes: S3 bucket storing transformed data in target format.

nodes.name: AURORA PG
nodes.notes: Data mart on Aurora PostgreSQL chosen for high query concurrency without licensing costs.

nodes.name: TABLEAU
nodes.notes: BI presentation tool connected to summarized data in Aurora PostgreSQL for dashboards and reports.

edges.notes: DMS pulls structured data from relational databases.
DMS pulls semi-structured data from bureau sources.
DMS loads extracted data into the S3 RAW staging bucket.
AWS Glue reads raw staging data from S3.
AWS Glue writes transformed target-format data into S3 PROCESSED.
AWS Glue loads transformed data into Aurora PostgreSQL data mart.
Tableau queries Aurora PostgreSQL presentation tables for reporting and analytics.
